name: Download a file (or a part) from this batch export run
description: Download a file (or a part) from this batch export run Download a file (or a part) from this batch export run. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/file_download_batch_exports/{id}/download/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/file_download_batch_exports/{id}/download/
Download a file (or a part) from this batch export run. Users can provide a part component with an id or index, or no part component at all: * If part id is included: The file download matching the id is downloaded. * If part index is included: The file download matching the index (as ordered by key) is downloaded. * If no part component is present: If there is only one file downloaded, that is downloaded. Otherwise the first one as sorted by key is downloaded.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this batch export run.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.

name: file_download_batch_exports_logs_retrieve
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/file_download_batch_exports/{id}/logs/
file_download_batch_exports_logs_retrieve
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this batch export run.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: after (query) — Only return entries after this ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to 7 days ago; pass an explicit value to read further back.; before (query) — Only return entries before this ISO 8601 timestamp.; instance_id (query) — Filter logs to a specific execution instance.; level (query) — Comma-separated log levels to include, e.g. 'WARN,ERROR'. Valid levels: DEBUG, LOG, INFO, WARN, ERROR.; limit (query) — Maximum number of log entries to return (1-500, default 50).; search (query) — Case-insensitive substring search across log messages.

name: Get a batch export on demand run
description: Get a batch export on demand run Get a batch export on demand run. GET /api/projects/{project_id}/file_download_batch_exports/{id}/
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/file_download_batch_exports/{id}/
Get a batch export on demand run. If the underlying batch export run has completed, we return keys to the generated file downloads so that users may download them by making a request to /download.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this batch export run.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
